title: 第1章 你重生了第2章 绝世天材变废材
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田

“我都说了我不要，你为什么总要逼我？行了行了，我依你便是，把火灵草拿来吧。”
沈青鱼刚从一阵窒息般的闷痛中猛地睁眼，耳边就炸响一道带着不耐与轻慢的声音，听得她眉峰瞬间拧紧。
这谁？
活腻歪了？竟敢用这种语气同她说话？
她沈青鱼从尸山血海中杀出一条血路，登上帝位，执掌整个皇朝生杀大权，数年来朝野上下，无人敢在她面前高声喧哗。
这厮怕不是猪油蒙了心，想屁吃！
沈青鱼缓缓睁开眼睛，随即神色一滞。
什么情况？
率先映入她眼帘的，赫然是周荣那张让她多看一眼都直泛恶心的脸，可记忆里这个人早就死了啊。
她僵硬转头，朝四周扫了眼，只觉莫名熟悉。
活见鬼了？
沈青鱼抬手，狠狠掐了自己一把。
疼，真疼。
【龙脉护持，逆天改命，你重生了。】
头顶有道声音炸响，沈青鱼眉头一皱，抬手朝头顶抓去。
“装神弄鬼。”
一坨屎一样的东西被她抓下来，有点眼熟，还没等看清就‘咻’一下跑了。
刚要再抓，那道恼人的声音再度响起。
“沈青鱼你还愣着做什么，我都已经答应你了，还不赶紧把火灵草拿来？”

见沈青鱼没反应，周荣的声音多了一丝急切。
说完不等沈青鱼回答，便理所当然地吩咐：“小桃，快去帮你家殿下把火灵草拿来。”
小桃看了眼沈青鱼，眼神微微闪烁，有些敷衍地行了个礼，快步朝宴厅后殿走去。
小梨一看，急得跺脚：“殿下，你真要把火灵草送给驸马爷吗？”
这人的不要脸与偏心都写在了脸上，殿下怎么就是看不到呢。
沈青鱼低头看了看，浑身湿漉漉的，水珠顺着脸颊滑下，滴答滴答。
刚发生了什么？
小梨以为她在哭，心疼不已，劝说道：“殿下，今日是您十八岁生辰，若错过这最后开脉机会，就真断了武道一途了。日后若是后悔再想开脉，必定困难重重，九死一生。”
沈青鱼心道，可不是困难么。
前世她后来虽然成功开脉，但过程如同坠入炼狱，遭受千刀万剐、万蚁噬身之痛。
如今她重生了，刚好回到这个关键节点。
就是记忆还有点模糊，不太记得发生了什么，似乎是有人把她推下水的。
朝四周看了看，视线落在不远处同样浑身湿漉漉，正昏迷着的女子身上。
正要开口说点什么，就被匆匆赶来的小桃打断。
“殿下，火灵草取来了。”小桃双手捧着药盒回来，话是对沈青鱼说的，眼睛却往周荣那里看。
周荣眼睛一亮，伸手就朝药盒抓去。
不料沈青鱼的手伸得比他还快，在他手碰到药盒前，迅速将药盒拿到手。
周荣拿了个空，顿时生出一股怒意来。
“沈青鱼，你什么意思？我都已经勉强同意把火灵草收下了，你……”周荣话还没说完，就不可置信地瞪大了眼睛。
只见沈青鱼打开药盒，从药盒里拿出一株通体赤红的灵草，动作迅速团吧团吧直接塞进嘴。

众人目瞪口呆。

"I already said I don't want it, why do you always have to force me? Okay, okay, I'll do whatever you want, bring the Fire Spirit Grass."
As soon as Shen Qingyu opened her eyes suddenly from a suffocating pain, a voice filled with impatience and contempt exploded in her ears, causing her eyebrows to tighten instantly.
Who is this?
Tired of living? How dare you speak to her in this tone?
She, Shen Qingyu, fought her way out of a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood, ascended to the throne of God, and took charge of the power of life and death in the entire dynasty. For several years, no one in the government or the public dared to make a loud noise in front of her.
I'm afraid this guy is obsessed with lard and wants to eat shit!
Shen Qingyu slowly opened his eyes, and then his expression froze.
What's going on?
The first thing that caught her eye was Zhou Rong's face that made her feel sick even if she looked at it again. But in her memory, this person was already dead.
She turned her head stiffly and glanced around, feeling strangely familiar.
What a hell?
Shen Qingyu raised his hand and pinched himself hard.
It hurts, it really hurts.
[Dragon Vein Protection, defying heaven and changing your fate, you are reborn. 】
There was an explosion above his head. Shen Qingyu frowned and raised his hand to grab the top of his head.
"Pretend to be a ghost."
She grabbed something that looked like shit. It looked familiar, but before she could see it clearly, it ran away with a 'whoosh'.
Just as he was about to grab it again, that annoying voice sounded again.
"Shen Qingyu, what are you still doing? I've already promised you, why don't you hurry up and get the Fire Spirit Grass?"
Seeing that Shen Qingyu didn't respond, Zhou Rong's voice became a little more urgent.
After speaking, without waiting for Shen Qingyu's reply, he ordered as a matter of course: "Xiao Tao, go and help your Highness get the Fire Spirit Grass."
Xiao Tao glanced at Shen Qingyu, her eyes flickered slightly, she saluted perfunctorily, and walked quickly towards the back hall of the banquet hall.
When Xiaoli saw it, she stamped her feet anxiously: "Your Highness, do you really want to give the Fire Spirit Grass to the Prince Consort?"
This man's shamelessness and partiality are written all over his face. Why can't His Highness see it?
Shen Qingyu looked down and saw that his whole body was wet, and water droplets slid down his cheeks, dripping.
What just happened?
Xiaoli thought she was crying and felt very distressed. She persuaded her, "Your Highness, today is your eighteenth birthday. If you miss this last opportunity to open your pulse, your career in martial arts will be ruined. If you regret it and try to open your pulse again in the future, it will be very difficult and you will almost die."
Shen Qingyu thought to himself, isn't it difficult?
Although she successfully opened her pulse in her previous life, the process was like falling into purgatory, suffering the pain of being cut into pieces by thousands of knives and eaten by thousands of ants.
Now that she is reborn, she has just returned to this critical node.
But my memory is still a bit fuzzy, I don't quite remember what happened. It seemed like someone pushed her into the water.
He looked around and his eyes fell on a woman not far away who was also wet and unconscious.
Just as he was about to say something, he was interrupted by Xiao Tao who came in a hurry.
"Your Highness, the Fire Spirit Grass is here." Xiao Tao came back with the medicine box in both hands. She was speaking to Shen Qingyu, but her eyes were looking at Zhou Rong.
Zhou Rong's eyes lit up and he reached out to grab the medicine box.
Unexpectedly, Shen Qingyu's hand stretched out faster than his, and quickly took the medicine box in his hand before his hand touched it.
Zhou Rong took it empty and suddenly felt angry.
"Shen Qingyu, what do you mean? I have reluctantly agreed to accept the Fire Spirit Grass, you..." Before Zhou Rong could finish his words, his eyes widened in disbelief.
Shen Qingyu opened the medicine box, took out a red spiritual grass from the medicine box, quickly stuffed it into his mouth.
Everyone was stunned.
